grades.question: Who may select London Season cards, in what order and with which tiebreakers? What happens to the display and unused pensioners afterward?

May peek at display blackmails. Stop when display empty. Discard remaining display and refill three, blackmail down/prestige up even if none taken. Return unretired pensioners to supply.
grades.observed_answer: Only players who retired at least one pensioner select or discard one display card. Order is descending actual total retirement spending; ties go to the most total windows, including new prizes, then clockwise from the PM. The acting player may peek at display blackmails. There is no immediate refill; if the display empties, remaining players are skipped. At the end discard remaining display cards and refill three even if nobody took one. Return unused pensioners to their supplies.
